test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks below will complete the letter series.

U _ G _ F _ K _ M G _ F N _ U _ G
solution:
Given series: U _ G _ F _ K _ M G _ F N _ U _ G​

Checking each option one by one:

Option 1) MLNULKM → U __**M**__ G __**L**__ F __**N**__ K __**U**__ M G __**L**__ F N __**K**__ U __**M**__ G → **(It follows the pattern of: U M G - L F**** N K - U M G - L F N K - U M G)**

Option 2) MKLNULM → U __M__ G __K__ F __L__ K __N__ M G __U__ F N __L__ U __M__ G → (It doesn't follow the pattern)

Option 3) NLMKULM → U __N__ G __L__ F __M__ K __K__ M G __U__ F N __L__ U __M__ G → (It doesn't follow the pattern)

Option 4) NKNMULM → U __N__ G __K__ F __N__ K __M__ M G __U__ F N __L__ U __M__ G → (It doesn't follow the pattern)

Thus, out of all the options 'option 1' follows the pattern.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
